title: When a Bus Becomes a Policy Problem: Kerala’s Intercity Mobility Crisis and the AITP Question
description: Kerala’s bus network is in structural decline. The availability of bus services in the state fell from one bus for every 910 people in 2000 to one for every 2,807 people in 2023 (CPPR, 2026).
